name: cortico-world-skillhost
description: Cortico World: 技能宿主。把 OmniAgent 的技能包（含 skill.json 与 index.js 的文件夹）放进一个目录，填好 Key，技能里注册的工具就变成可调用的工具；设置页能按技能分页填 Key、开关、卸载。要求 Cortico 0.2.0 / Coopanion 0.2.5 及以上。

zh.description: 把 OmniAgent 的技能包（zip 解压后的文件夹）放进技能目录，它自己读 skill.json、加载 index.js，把技能里注册的工具变成我能调用的工具；Key、接口地址、发送目标用设置页或 skill_config 填。技能丢进去不用重启，每个技能可以单独关掉。

en.description: Drop an OmniAgent skill folder into the skills directory; it reads skill.json, loads index.js and turns the skill's registered tools into tools I can call. Keys, base URLs and the send target are set in the settings page or with skill_config. New skills are picked up without a restart, and each skill can be switched off on its own.
